build_task_with_define_task: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE spatial reasoning task
create_box_with_add_box: call C.add_box(width, height) to create a box body and chain set_bottom and set_left to position it
set_spatial_relationship_ABOVE: pass C.SpatialRelationship.ABOVE in the relationships list to define an above spatial relationship between two bodies
update_task_with_bodies: call C.update_task with body1, body2, relationships, and description to finalize a PHYRE task definition
review_build_task_function: review the build_task function to understand how boxes are positioned and related via spatial relationships
